BiblicalUsage: Female is the word that pairs with male from the first page of the Bible: God creates man in His image, male and female He creates them. The law then carries the pair through sacrifice, cleansing, and the camp itself — a female offering without blemish, male and female put outside the camp together, no graven image in the likeness of either.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe male and female together bear God's image, and neither half of the pair can carry it alone. That is why the law guards the pair so carefully — in sacrifice, in the camp, and in the image itself.
